subject: Combining reshape with the {tables} package for prettier nested tables

messages.author: b24c10731fdfceaf
messages.subject: Combining reshape with the {tables} package for prettier nested tables
parts:
Hello dear useRs,

After playing around with it, I wrote a small function called "tabular.cast_df" which "bridges" between the {reshape} and the new {tables} package (for more on Duncan's package, see here: http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tables/vignettes/tables.pdf).

Motivation: it makes "cast_df" table prettier in the R terminal, as well as allow us to export a pretty version of the table to latex (using Hmisc::latex, on the output of tabular.cast_df)

The code is now available on my blog:
http://www.r-statistics.com/2012/01/printing-nested-tables-in-r-bridging-between-the-reshape-and-tables-packages/

I would be happy for any input/revisions/suggestions from you.

With regards,
Tal
